name: EWE Rechenzentrum Osnabrück
notes: EWE's business colocation page states that its high-availability data centers are located in Oldenburg and Osnabrück and offer colocation, server rooms, redundant power and cooling, 100% green power, ISO/IEC 27001 and TÜViT TSI certification. DataCenterMap corroborates EWE TEL colocation facilities in Oldenburg and Osnabrück.

name: Rechenzentrum Universität Osnabrück
notes: University data center building at Neuer Graben 29 in Osnabrück; Heinze lists a new-build completion in August 2019 and describes the building as housing the university data center and building management. The university describes its Rechenzentrum as the central backbone for IT-supported study, teaching, research and administration processes.

name: Landkreis Osterholz / Stadt Osterholz-Scharmbeck shared backup data center
notes: Official intermunicipal cooperation page says the district and Osterholz-Scharmbeck jointly use a backup data center in a district-owned building.

name: Telis Energie Deutschland Mehrum data center campus
notes: Campus planned near Mehrum in Hohenhameln, Landkreis Peine. NDR reported six buildings on about 380,000 sqm, at least EUR 1 billion investment, council initiation of planning, and possible 2028 construction start. DataCenter-Insider reports a planned connection load of around 500 MW for a multi-tenant colocation campus. Municipality has a public planning page for the FNP amendment and 'Rechenzentrum' development plan.

name: Klinikum Peine container data center
notes: CANCOM reference describes a modernized data-center network for Klinikum Peine using a containerized data center solution, NetApp All-Flash MetroCluster and Veeam/ProLion security tooling. Local press reported in 2022 that the hospital's new data center fit into two containers.

name: Avacon Netzdatencenter Salzgitter-Watenstedt
notes: Avacon laid the foundation stone on August 16, 2022 for a new network data center at its Salzgitter-Watenstedt operating site. Energy & Management reported a 1,000 sqm energy data center intended for operation in June 2023 with more than 900 TB storage and 120 virtual machines for energy network data. KO Technik lists commissioning support for the Avacon new data center in Salzgitter during 2023-2024.

name: Landkreis Schaumburg central school IT data center
notes: Local press reports Landkreis Schaumburg school IT has a central data center located in a former caretaker house. Exact capacity not disclosed.

name: Kreishaus Uelzen data center
notes: Depenbrock reference for the Landkreis Uelzen Kreishaus new-build lists special areas including a Rechenzentrum and population-protection control room. AZ reported detail works for the new Kreishaus included video surveillance for the data center.

name: Rechenzentrum Verden GmbH modernization
developer: Rechenzentrum Verden GmbH / Data Center Group
notes: Data Center Group brochure cites Rechenzentrum Verden GmbH as technical service provider for Vereinigte Informationssysteme Tierhaltung and describes chiller replacement/data-center modernization for efficiency. Kreiszeitung local reporting confirms an established vit/Rechenzentrum operation in Verden.
